title: Towards a Simplified Theory of Double Boolean Algebras: Axioms and Topological Representation
summary: Double Boolean algebras (dBas), introduced by Wille, are based on twenty-three identities. We present a simplified axiom system, the D-core algebra, and prove it is equivalent to Wille's original definition. This reduction allows improved structural results, including a refined Boolean representation theorem showing fewer conditions suffice to represent a dBa as a pair of Boolean algebras linked by adjoint maps.
